easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Blim.
When Blim deals combat damage, Blim triggers, causing (among other effects) target opponent to gain control of Surrak.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Surrak.
Surrak's last ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Surrak.
Repeat from step 5 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
